messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30, when on-call passed from Tomasz. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-06-19, until the next rotation. [valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-05-13, until the next rotation. [valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-04-03, replacing Priya Raman. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12. [valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
- As of 2025-12-05, the reporting service is owned by the Ember team, having transferred from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
    earlier: The reporting service is a Dune team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-12-05; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2025-12-05, the pager for the reporting service rings the Ember team, not the Dune team. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-26 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-26]
- On 2026-04-14, the Dune team observed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- On 2026-03-20, on-call for the Boreal team passed from Marcus to Lena. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
- As of 2026-05-29, Diego is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the Dune team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- The reporting service stopped using the ledger service because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- On 2025-07-30, on-call for the Atlas team passed from Tomasz to Priya Raman when Tomasz moved to the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [constraint; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-09]
- On 2026-05-22, Tomasz picked up the Dune team on-call shift from Farah. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22]
- The Dune team owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-03-20. [valid 2025-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-20]
- On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- As of 2026-06-04, for anything Atlas-related, page Priya Raman, not Marcus, since she has the Atlas team pager this cycle. [decision; valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-06-04]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-08, for anything Atlas-related, page Marcus, not Priya Raman. [decision; valid 2026-04-08 to 2026-06-04; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
    earlier: For anything Atlas-related, page Priya Raman. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-08; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- The Boreal team observed on 2025-11-03 that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03-2]
